jobs.description: About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . Global Head of Enterprise Standards The Opportunity Analog Devices is seeking a Global Head of Enterprise Standards to provide executive leadership for software quality, functional safety, product security assurance, and Responsible AI governance across products, software, systems, and emerging technologies. This role will shape the strategies, operating models, capabilities, and assurance practices that enable ADI to deliver safe, secure, reliable, and trustworthy products while accelerating responsible innovation. As the enterprise leader for these four critical disciplines, you will partner with executive leadership, engineering organizations, product groups, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and business teams to embed quality, safety, security, and responsible AI throughout the product and technology lifecycle. A core part of Responsible AI governance will be establishing effective data governance for AI, recognizing that trustworthy outcomes depend on the quality, provenance, ownership, protection, permitted use, and ongoing stewardship of the data used to train, validate, deploy, and monitor AI systems. Standards engagement, certification readiness, regulatory coordination, and governance frameworks will serve as key enablers of this mission, strengthening customer trust, managing enterprise risk, and supporting ADI’s technology leadership. Responsibilities Quality, Safety, Security, and Responsible AI Set the global strategy and operating model for software quality, functional safety, product security assurance, and Responsible AI governance. Lead and develop global teams of technical leaders and subject-matter experts across these four disciplines. Drive software development quality and process maturity through risk-based assurance, lifecycle governance, measurement, independent oversight, and continuous improvement. Establish functional safety capabilities that integrate hazard analysis, safety planning, safety cases, assessment, and assurance into product and system development. Direct product security assurance across secure development lifecycles, security risk assessment, vulnerability management, product incident readiness, and independent assurance. Lead Responsible AI governance, including integrated AI and data governance, use-case risk classification, lifecycle controls, human oversight, evaluation, monitoring, and accountability. Establish data governance as a foundational element of AI governance, with clear accountability for data ownership and stewardship, data quality and fitness for purpose, provenance and lineage, access and usage rights, privacy and security, retention, third-party data, documentation, and controls for training, validation, deployment, and monitoring data. Partner with enterprise data, privacy, security, legal, and engineering leaders to ensure AI data practices are consistent, traceable, risk-based, and aligned with business objectives and responsible-use commitments. Ensure development processes support safe, secure, reliable, high-quality, and trustworthy products and solutions. Define performance measures and assurance reporting that provide executive visibility into maturity, risk, product readiness, and business outcomes. Enable responsible innovation at scale by embedding proportionate quality, safety, security, and AI governance practices early in the product and technology lifecycle. Standards, Certification, and Regulatory Enablement Use relevant standards, regulatory requirements, and certification programs to strengthen software quality, functional safety, product security, and Responsible AI capabilities. Lead the ADI Standards Office and focus external engagement on standards that materially support product assurance, innovation, customer needs, and market access. Monitor emerging requirements, assess their implications for the four core disciplines, and sponsor timely readiness plans. Coordinate enterprise product regulatory activities for CE marking, including applicable EU requirements, conformity-assessment planning, technical documentation, testing and certification evidence, EU Declarations of Conformity, and cross-functional market-readiness decisions. Oversee certification readiness and continuous improvement where certification provides strategic, customer, regulatory, or operational value. External Engagement and Industry Influence Represent ADI in selected standards organizations, industry consortia, certification organizations, and regulatory forums relevant to software quality, functional safety, product security, and Responsible AI. Build strategic relationships with customers, regulators, certification partners, standards bodies, and industry peers. Influence future industry practices and benchmarks in areas important to ADI’s products, technologies, and customers. Position ADI as a recognized leader in safe, secure, high-quality, and trustworthy technology development. Organizational Leadership and Business Impact Lead global, multidisciplinary teams and subject-matter experts across software quality, functional safety, product security assurance, Responsible AI, and supporting standards activities. Set organizational direction, deploy resources, develop talent, and build succession plans for critical technical and governance capabilities. Drive alignment among business units, engineering organizations, and corporate functions on risk-based product assurance priorities. Advise and mentor technical and business leaders on quality, safety, security, trustworthy AI, and responsible innovation. Establish measures for process maturity, product readiness, risk reduction, assurance effectiveness, audit and certification outcomes, and business value. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, software engineering, quality, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Extensive leadership experience in the semiconductor, technology, software, embedded systems, or a related industry. Demonstrated executive expertise in multiple core areas among software quality, functional safety, product security assurance, and Responsible AI governance, with the ability to integrate them into an enterprise operating model. Proven experience building and leading global technical organizations and influencing complex, cross-functional stakeholder groups. Strong understanding of product and software development lifecycles, risk-based assurance, independent assessment, governance, and continuous improvement. Demonstrated success improving organizational maturity and embedding quality, safety, security, or trustworthy AI practices into engineering execution. Exceptional executive communication, influencing, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in engineering, computer science, technology, business, or a related discipline. Experience leading enterprise software quality or software process improvement programs, including assurance, metrics, corrective action, and lifecycle governance. Experience with functional safety engineering and assurance for safety-related products or systems. Experience leading product security assurance, secure development, security risk management, or product vulnerability governance. Experience establishing integrated Responsible AI and data governance frameworks, including data ownership and stewardship, quality and fitness for purpose, provenance and lineage, access controls, privacy, security, documentation, and lifecycle oversight for AI-enabled systems. Working knowledge of relevant quality, functional safety, cybersecurity, software process maturity, and AI management-system standards and frameworks. Experience coordinating product regulatory compliance and CE-marking activities across engineering, quality, legal, regulatory, operations, and business teams. Experience representing a company in selected certification bodies, consortia, regulatory forums, or standards development organizations. Why You Will Like Working at ADI At Analog Devices, you will shape how software quality, functional safety, product security assurance, and Responsible AI are built into breakthrough innovation across the intelligent edge. Scopely
is seeking an experienced a
Lead Finance Analyst/Manage
r to join Product Finance in support of our LIVE Games Portfolio — a group of live-operated, top-grossing mobile games generating meaningful revenue for Scopely. This is a senior, high-visibility role for someone ready to operate as a true finance business partner: owning financial models end-to-end, driving KPI and performance reporting, and initiating the projects that shape how the portfolio is managed.
Based out of our Barcelona office, you will partner directly with General Managers and cross-functional stakeholders across game studios, User Acquisition, Data Science and Finance leadership, Accounting, and central teams. You will be a key voice in portfolio-level decision-making, translating data and models into clear recommendations for senior leadership. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, exhibit the highest personal and professional integrity, and work effectively with supervision while independently managing recurring monthly and quarterly deliverables.
Unlike an entry-level analyst role, this position calls for someone who can operate with a high degree of autonomy — identifying problems, initiating and leading projects, and managing senior stakeholders across the organization with minimal oversight, while still delivering the operational rigor (forecasting, close support, variance analysis) that keeps the portfolio running smoothly
Why This Role Stands Out
Strategic Ownership:
Own end-to-end financial modeling, forecasting, and reporting for titles within the LIVE Games Portfolio, presenting directly to senior game and finance leadership.
Stakeholder Leadership:
Serve as the primary finance point of contact for a broad set of cross-functional partners — game GMs, UA, Data/BI, Accounting — building the trusted relationships that shape business decisions.
Project Initiation:
Identify opportunities and lead process improvement and automation projects — forecasting model redesigns, KPI dashboard builds, reporting infrastructure — from scoping through execution.
Global Portfolio Exposure:
Work across Scopely's live games portfolio from our Barcelona hub, collaborating daily with teams across the US, EMEA, and beyond.
Top Talent Environment:
Join a high-caliber team with backgrounds in consulting, banking, private equity, and high-growth tech from companies such as Amazon, Google, and Netflix.
Career Trajectory:
Senior individual contributors on this team have a clear path to Finance Manager / Senior Manager roles with expanding portfolio and people-leadership scope.
Tech-Forward Finance:
Be part of an AI-powered FP&A team, contributing to the automation of reporting and the build-out of predictive, self-serve tools.
What We’re Looking For:
Experience:
5+ years in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or strong analytical roles, ideally with exposure to gaming, mobile apps, subscription, or consumer tech business models.
Financial Modeling & Analytics:
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex revenue, UA, and cost models, and to translate large datasets into clear KPI narratives.
Stakeholder Management:
Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders across functions, build consensus, and influence decisions without direct authority.
Project Leadership:
A track record of scoping and driving cross-functional projects to completion, from process redesign to new reporting infrastructure.
Commercial Acumen:
Strong understanding of the KPIs that drive live-service/mobile games businesses (e.g., DAU/MAU, ARPDAU, LTV, ROAS, retention) and how they connect to financial performance.
Tools:
Familiarity with BI and data visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and financial planning systems (e.g., Workday Adaptive Planning) strongly preferred; SQL is a plus.
Communication:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise recommendations for leadership.
Location:
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona, with the flexibility to collaborate across time zones with US and global teams.
Passion:
A genuine interest in games, consumer products, or technology-driven businesses.
